summary: Genprex, Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) disclosing a press release on translational biomarker results for its lead gene-therapy candidate REQORSA (quaratusugene ozeplasmid). The data, presented in a poster at the Gerontological Society of America 2026 Annual Scientific Meeting (Nov 4-7, National Harbor, Maryland), derive from whole-blood transcriptomes of 11 lung cancer patients across two trials, sampled pre-dose and at 5 and 24 hours, showing a biphasic immune-then-cellular-maintenance response. No transaction, capital, or governance event is present; this is a routine product-data current report with no deal terms, no board recommendation, and no arbitrage angle.
